_comment: Metric-regression baselines for `make tune-check` (the DESIGN-TUNING-LOOP.md defense half). COMMITTED REFERENCE VALUES, regenerable: `make tune-baseline` (= scripts/tune-check.sh --update-baseline) re-runs the cheap synthetic benches and rewrites this file, so when an INTENDED improvement lands the founder refreshes the baseline deliberately (K14: the machine proposes, the human commits the new reference). The guard runs pp-retrieval-eval --synthetic (deterministic IR metrics over a 3-image in-process corpus, no models, no real DB) and pp-bench ingest (small --files synthetic ingest) and fails if any metric regresses past its tolerance. Run it locally before a perf- or ranking-touching change; the cheap synthetic form is CI-able on any machine (zero setup).

ingest._comment: Synthetic ingest throughput (pp-bench ingest --files 24 --edge 512). files_per_s is HIGHER-IS-BETTER; the guard fails only if it drops below baseline * (1 - tolerance). tolerance is GENEROUS (0.15 = allow a 15% slowdown) AND DOCUMENTED-WHY: ingest throughput is dominated by JPEG decode/resize/encode + hashing on the host CPU, so it swings with machine speed, core count, thermal state, and concurrent load. A tight threshold would red-flag a slower CI runner or a busy laptop, not a real regression. 15% is wide enough to absorb that machine/load variance while still catching a genuine algorithmic slowdown (e.g. an accidental O(n^2) or a dropped parallel pass), which shows up as a multiples-of-15% cliff, not a few-percent drift. The baseline value is host-specific by nature: regenerate it on the machine the guard will run on (`make tune-baseline`).

search._comment: Synthetic retrieval-eval (pp-retrieval-eval --synthetic). The fixture is deterministic and the keyword rig ranks every answer first, so these are 1.0 on a healthy rig on EVERY machine. tolerance is ABSOLUTE: a metric may not drop below baseline - tolerance. 0.02 matches the spec's stated geometry tolerance and is tight because the number is machine-independent: any drop here means a real ranking/fusion regression, not noise.
